title: File control: READ GTEQ and READ GENERIC (KEYLENGTH prefix, with and without GTEQ) over a seeded KSDS; NOTFND (RESP2 80)

scenarios.summary: READ GTEQ KEYLENGTH(4): the absent A150 returns the next greater record A200, the exact B100 returns B100, B400 above the last key is NOTFND RESP2 80, A000 below the first returns A100

READ GENERIC KEYLENGTH(1|2): the first record starting with the prefix (A, B), NOTFND RESP2 80 for a prefix no key has (C, A4); with GTEQ an absent prefix returns the first greater key (A4 -> B100, B2 -> B300); KEYLENGTH(3) is a valid prefix (A20 -> A200)
